question: In a certain code language, 'HEAVY' is coded as 'EBXSV'. What is the code for ‘LABEL’ in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Logic: Position of alphabets of first word (- 3).

'HEAVY' is coded as 'EBXSV'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da1f27e1bad4ed42f3aa4cbbf2adfa1248c76e076ad0963bc459f595bd776069.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a444ceb916ca28d548040ec08b69fe2c72c1b9cd046cb0b84ea0fec758998a3b.png] 

Similarly,

‘LABEL’ will be coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71dda547a7993648e68e72236285de0f77c086d06baf8bfc394b7ba0b5711acd.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea823179b0ba130cf5ab569a3dc732ab09a6542f7966bb1b0856ccbeb081b04b.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"IXYBI".**
